system.description:
These devices are capable of projecting high-definition, ultra-realistic three-dimensional images and movies. From a distance (20+ meters), such holograms can be difficult to distinguish as fake, but up close they are easier to see for what they are (+20 Perception Test modifier). Holograms do not appear wavelengths other than visual light, and so are easily identified by anyone with enhanced vision.

Source: Eclipse Phase Core Rulebook, p. 325.
